# Public evidence response fixtures

Each JSON contains the retrieval date, exact URL, digest of the original HTTP body, and a selected projection of the upstream JSON. The digest identifies the original body. This repository redistributes only identifiers and structural metadata. Search and retrieval results remain untrusted tool content.

| Fixture | Terms for source data |
|---|---|
| epmc and bioc | Bibliographic and abstract rights depend on the source publication. No abstract text is included. [Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/Copyright) and [NCBI policies](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/) |
| gwas | The curated association record is subject to EBI Services Terms of Use. Individual summary statistics have separate terms. [GWAS Catalog](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/docs/faq/) |
| trials | ClinicalTrials.gov data, retrieved 2026-11-21. [Terms and conditions](https://clinicaltrials.gov/terms-conditions) |
| hpa | Human Protein Atlas gene identifiers. HPA uses CC BY 4.0 for copyrightable database content with separate terms for external data. [HPA licence and attribution](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence) |
| label | openFDA label identifier and effective date. Private submissions can contain copyrightable material. [openFDA terms](https://open.fda.gov/terms/) |

Existing MCP replays are in the sibling mcp directory. Source fields identify the recorded server. BioMCP source-specific restrictions apply to its upstream material. Open Targets uses CC0 for its own data with upstream exceptions. [BioMCP source licensing](https://biomcp.org/reference/source-licensing/) and [Open Targets licence](https://platform-docs.opentargets.org/licence)
